## Priority

<!-- Pick one: -->

- [ ] **P1** — Blocks an upcoming milestone (e.g. content launch, public announcement)
- [ ] **P2** — Wanted soon, no hard deadline
- [ ] **P3** — Nice-to-have, future
- [ ] **Someday** — Not committed, parked for later

## Estimated effort

<!-- Rough order of magnitude. Useful for triage. -->

- [ ] **XS** — < 1 hour
- [ ] **S** — 1–4 hours
- [ ] **M** — 4–8 hours / one focused day
- [ ] **L** — More than a day, may need to break down
